name: Summary of Reserve Order
query:
SELECT 
(SELECT CONCAT(currency, " ",FORMAT(price_list_rate,2)) FROM `tabItem Price` WHERE item_code = %(product_bundle)s AND selling = 1) `Harga Jual:Data:150`
, ipb.item_code `item_code`
, CONCAT(ipb.`currency`, " ", FORMAT(ipb.price_list_rate,2)) `HPP:Data:150`
FROM `tabProduct Bundle Item` pbi
LEFT JOIN `tabItem Price` ipb ON pbi.item_code = ipb.item_code AND ipb.buying = 1
WHERE pbi.parent = %(product_bundle)s
